receipted_answers.macro_context_effect: Parent regimes differ (C 132 vs 125; PC 116 vs 111) via macro target selection. Under response-only and target-completeness the regime gap persists; under persistence/full-stack it collapses to zero because held exposure never re-reads the regime surface.
receipted_answers.why_both_full_stacks_converged_to_C94_PC: The full-stack C event sets are IDENTICAL across macro-hold and macro-micro (94 shared events). Persistence dominates the stack: it pins sibling exposure to the same held prices in both regimes, erasing the macro-context differences that separate the parents (132 vs 125 C). The shared surviving set yields identical C=94/PC=88/S=77 with only IC differing (32 vs 33).
receipted_answers.why_persistence_sharply_reduced_C_and_PC: Persistence HOLD lawfully retained the original X against headroom/LIVE-AIM/macro reprice suggestions. The receipted event-level effect: 30 (hold) / 27 (micro) C losses, of which 24 (hold) / 18 (micro) are behavioral_shifted_fill_landed_post_right (the held/late-walked exposure fill fact landed after the guarded cutoff), 5/7 true never-filled legs, and 1/2 admission artifacts. Every one of the 30/27 lost events carries t1_persistence_hold receipts on the lost leg: lawful queue preservation measurably missed the later reprice path that filled the parent in-window. Lawful is not good: persistence-only cost 23/20 PC.
receipted_answers.why_response_only_finished_below_parents: All three response-only PC deficits (PASKRU in both regimes, FEAWAL in macro-micro) are admission-law surface differences, not behavior: the T1 stream fill facts are IDENTICAL to the parent stream fill facts (KRU X=30 @1783934608.97 vs cutoff 1783932900; FEA X=46 @1783883078.08 vs cutoff 1783882200), both post-right. The T1 scoring package admits only in-window frozen simulated fills; the parent results package credited guarded FILLABLE_AT_X evidence within the window (KRU@36, FEA@48). Response-only produced zero true behavioral C/PC losses and zero gains: its 476,710 explicit decisions were all HOLDs on already-active exposure.
receipted_answers.why_target_completeness_raised_C_but_not: Genuine gains exist: +4C/+3PC (hold) and +5C/+3PC (micro) from new in-window fills at complete headroom targets. But the modified exposure sequence also shifted 5 (hold) and 5 (micro) previously-PC events so their eventual fill facts landed post-right (behavioral_shifted_fill), netting PC 116->114 and 111->109 while C rose 132->134 and 125->128. Two of the gained completions per regime are completed_non_PC (combined delta not strictly negative), so C rose more than PC.
